name: tia_compile
description: Compile PLC software to check syntax, consistency, and generate machine code. Returns errors, warnings, and messages. TIA Portal compiles only changed blocks; Openness has no rebuild-all option. When no block needed compiling the result has UpToDate true and a Note, and warnings from an earlier compile are not repeated (see tia_get_compile_state).

plc_name.description: Name of the target PLC to compile (optional, defaults to first PLC).
